managed.what: The managed paper book: starts from the account twin's holdings and acts on the evening cut list; each cut's rupees buy a replacement from the Nifty 500 chosen by the proved not-losing rules; tracked against the twin, the frozen portfolio and the Nifty 500 (india/managed.py).
managed.fills: at the session's official open from the exchange bhavcopy, plus slippage_pct and delivery costs; a buy opening more than max_gap_pct above the last close is skipped (no chase)
managed.exits_for_replacements: a close at or under the fixed stop; after min_hold_sessions a close under the 200-day average; the twin's original holdings leave only through the cut list
